_about: ROADMAP v3 candidate cards (P0c). A card moves stage card -> rules_read -> pre_registered -> validated/rejected -> shadow -> promoted. rules.status UNKNOWN means the paper's rule section has not been read yet: no params may be invented, and the card cannot be pre-registered until it is filled from the source. family must match gate.FAMILIES (P0a). trial_budget = the most param sets we will ever run for it; each one is a trial in N.

rules.text: BTC bought at first tradable open, held (bh_net).
